Profile Templates
  • AJA AV Network
    To connect AJA Dante AV systems. For quick auto detection and for ease of configuration.
  • Allen & Heath gigaACE/GX
    To connect two audio devices from Allen & Heath in a Layer 2 VLAN only, across one or multiple switches. Supported protocols include gigaACE and GX.
  • AUDAC Audio and Control Network
    To connect AUDAC devices and AUDAC devices requiring separation of audio and control traffic into different VLANs. Compatible with Dante and AES67.
  • Audio AES67
    To connect IP Audio AES67 InterComm devices and their controller. This profile enables PTP TC. This IEEE 1588 (section 10 and 11.5) PTPv2 Transparent Clock (TC) 1-Step End-to-End feature is updating the residence time of the PTPv2 packets from ingress to egress in the switch using the "Sync" & "Delay_Req" fields. PTP TC is required by the Intercomm AES67 applications.
  • Audio Audio-Technica
    For connecting Audio-Technica Commercial Audio microphones, speakers, digital mixers, and wireless systems.
  • Audio Basalte Multiroom
    For connecting IP Basalte Plano, Aalto and Ceilo Speaker systems and controller.
  • Audio Dante
    To connect IP Audio Dante devices and their controller. Supported devices include Audinate, AED, Biamp, Bose, Genelec, Harman, RTS, Sennheiser, Shure, Trinnov Audio, Waves, etc.
  • Audio Genelec Smart IP
    To connect Genelec Smart IP active PoE+ loudspeakers and various control systems.
  • Audio Q-SYS
    To connect IP Audio Q-SYS devices and their controller
  • Audio Soundgrid
    To connect IP Audio SoundGrid devices and their controllers.
  • Audio Video AVB
    To connect IP Audio Video AVB devices and their controller.
  • Audio Video AVB MILAN
    To connect IP Audio Video AVB MILAN devices and their controller.
  • Audio Video AVB MILAN with Dante PTPv1 PTPv2 or AES67
    To connect IP Audio Video AVB and Dante or AES67 devices and their respective controllers in the same VLAN. Limitations: MTU is 1500 by default and PTP-TC is not configurable on that VLAN.
  • Avid S6L
    To connect Avid VENUE | S6L Live Sound Ethernet AVB ports A or B. This is a one VLAN solution only, on the M4250 or M4350 switches supporting AVB. Applicable to VLAN 1 only, and no other VLAN is permitted on that switch.
  • AVoIP Lightware AV network
    To connect Lightware AVoIP endpoints and their control devices from the UBEX product family.
  • BirdDog AV Network
    To connect BirdDog AV systems. For quick auto detection and for ease of configuration.
  • BluOS AV
    To connect BluOS AV systems. For quick auto detection and for ease of configuration.
  • Blustream Multicast
    Works with all Blustream Multicast Video over IP product, including those that feature Dante / AES67
  • Crestron DigitalMedia AV Network
    To connect Crestron DM NVX (video), Crestron DM NAX (audio), Crestron cameras (NDI), PCs, and other Crestron Control network devices.
  • Data
    To connect PCs and other Control network devices. CobraNet is supported in a VLAN other than VLAN 1.
  • DICENTIS Conference system
    DICENTIS Conference system equipment with RPVSTP and IGMP support.
  • ETC Lighting
    To connect ETC lighting and control devices.
  • G&D KVM-over-IP
    To connect Guntermann & Drunck KVM-over-IP Solutions.
  • HARMAN Professional AV Network
    For connecting HARMAN Professional product lines together, advanced using auto detection of devices.
  • Kramer AV
    To connect Kramer AV over IP solutions for audio and video distribution over up to 4 different VLANs (video, control, audio, and aux).
  • Lighting
    To connect sACN, Art-Net, and MA-Net3 network devices, for controlling lighting equipment.
  • Nice Home Management
    To connect Nice Home Management systems, including IPD Dante with either Unicast or Multicast configurations. For quick auto detection and ease of configuration.
  • NUCLEUS Converged AV Network
    To connect EvertzAV NUCLEUS Session Manager and UXP gateways on a single converged network.
  • Pharos Lighting Control
    To connect Pharos Control Devices (management).
  • Pharos Lighting Data
    To connect Pharos Lighting Devices (data - lighting).
  • Poly StudioNet Modular Room
    Connect HP Poly StudioNet Modular Room peripherals.
  • Sennheiser TeamConnect Bar S - Single Domain Mode
    To connect Sennheiser TeamConnect Bar S in Single Domain Mode.
  • Shure Converged Audio and Control Network
    To connect Shure devices requiring audio and control traffic on a single VLAN. Compatible with Dante, AES67, QSYS, and Biamp Dante devices.
  • Shure Split Audio and Control Network
    To connect Shure devices requiring separation of audio and control traffic into different VLANs. Compatible with Dante, AES67, QSYS, and Biamp Dante devices.
  • Sonos
    To connect the Sonos smart home sound system.
  • Telos Alliance / Livewire+ AES67
    To connect Telos Alliance Livewire+ products and others that are AES67 compliant
  • Unite Audio
    Glidenet audio streaming. PCM, multichannel, ultra high definition, and compressed bit-perfect audio over networks.
  • URC Automation
    To connect URC Automation HDA devices and their controller
  • Video
    To connect IP Video devices and their controller. Audio can be sent and received using another VLAN tag in another profile simultaneously. Supported devices include NVX, AMX, ZeeVee, Aurora, Base-IP, Kramer, Atlona, ATEN, CYP, Liberty, PIXELHUE, Visionary, Wyrestorm, Yealink,Extron NAV, Dante AV, Muxlab, Netvio, VuWall, IPMX, SDVoE & etc.
  • Video NDI4
    To connect NDI Version 4 (mTCP) video devices and cameras. Supported devices include AVer, Avonic, BirdDog, Bolin, Canon, JVC, Kiloview, Lumens, Magewell, Ross, Panasonic, PTZOptics, Sony, Vizrt, etc.
  • Video NDI5 / NDI6 with Dante, Q-Sys or AES67 audio
    To connect NDI Version 5 and Version 6 (RUDP) video devices and cameras. Audio Dante, Q-SYS or AES67 is supported at the same time in the same VLAN. Supported devices include AVer, Avonic, BirdDog, Bolin, Canon, JVC, Kiloview, Lumens, Magewell, Ross, Panasonic, PTZOptics, Sony, Vizrt, etc.
  • Video with AES67 audio
    To connect IP Video devices and their controller. Audio AES67 supported at the same time in the same VLAN. Supported devices include NVX, AMX, ZeeVee, Aurora, Base-IP, Kramer, Atlona, ATEN, CYP, Liberty, PIXELHUE, Visionary, Wyrestorm, Yealink, Extron NAV, Dante AV, Muxlab, Netvio, VuWall, IPMX, SDVoE & etc.
  • Video with Dante audio
    To connect IP Video devices and their controller. Audio Dante supported at the same time in the same VLAN. Supported devices include NVX, AMX, ZeeVee, Aurora, Base-IP, Kramer, Atlona, ATEN, CYP, Liberty, PIXELHUE, Visionary, Wyrestorm, Yealink, Extron NAV, Dante AV, Muxlab, Netvio, VuWall, IPMX, SDVoE & etc.
  • Video with Q-SYS audio
    To connect IP Video devices and their controller. Audio Q-SYS supported at the same time in the same VLAN. Supported devices include NVX, AMX, ZeeVee, Aurora, Base-IP, Kramer, Atlona, ATEN, Liberty, PIXELHUE, Wyrestorm, Yealink, Extron NAV, Dante AV, IPMX, SDVoE & etc. (1,500 MTU)
  • Visionary Advanced Multi-Domain
    This profile will allow you to configure video, audio, and expansion together
  • Visionary AV Network
    To connect Visionary AV systems. For quick auto detection and for ease of configuration.
